mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces discount rates for equity valuation, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A three-month consecutive rise in unemployment rate above 7.0% signals deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when UNRATE exceeds 7.0% for 3 months, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts and retail sales indicate contracting consumer demand, triggering negative earnings expectations and S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when both HOUST and RSAFS decline, or interaction term Rank IC falls below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In a manufacturing recovery regime, sustained industrial production above 100.0 for two consecutive months signals improving output capacity that boosts corporate profits and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO exceeds 100.0 for two months, or Rank IC remains below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly year-over-year CPI increase exceeding 2.5% signals accelerating inflation that triggers monetary tightening expectations, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when CPIAUCSL YoY exceeds 2.5%, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: A quarterly real GDP growth rate above 2.0% signals robust economic expansion that supports corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when GDPC1 growth exceeds 2.0%, or Rank IC remains below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle labor market regime, monthly non-farm payrolls below 100,000 new jobs signal weakening economic momentum that reduces corporate earnings growth, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when PAYEMS growth is below 100,000, or Rank IC falls below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly housing starts decline below 900,000 units signals housing sector contraction that reduces consumer wealth and spending, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when HOUST is below 900.0, or Rank IC remains below 0.03.
